meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 它充当新用户首次对话的向导,按顺序带你走六条流程:功能导览、从其他工具迁移配置、翻看你过去的编码会话、按真实用量估算缓存省下的成本、全程随时记录你的偏好,以及首次深度初始化提议。全程用你的语言回答。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始使用 omo 时触发。它一生只自动启动一次,之后可用 senpi --onboard 重新唤起,也能用 omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled 关掉自动启动。

say.text: 我是从 Claude Code 过来的,帮我看看怎么迁移配置
say.note: 它先读你本机配置,给出迁移计划并等你同意

say.text: 能翻一下我之前的编码会话吗?
say.note: 它先征求同意,同意后分析你过去的工作习惯

say.text: 帮我算算 omo 缓存大概能省多少
say.note: 依据本地会话日志,需要先看过过往会话

howto.what_en: It guides a new omo user's first conversation: feature tour, migration from other coding agents, session archaeology, a quantified savings estimate, ongoing memory recording, and a first-session init-deep proposal. It replies in the user's language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts once only; it can be brought back with the senpi --onboard flag, or turned off.

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code; help me migrate my setup
say_en.note: It reads your existing config, shows a plan, waits for your yes

say_en.text: Can you look through my previous coding sessions?
say_en.note: It asks permission first, then mines your working patterns

say_en.text: Estimate what omo caching would have saved me
say_en.note: Based on local session logs; needs lane 3 data first
